core-pod.step.perform.says: Doing the work of one import step: taking in the new records.

core-pod.step.commit.says: Writing the step's results to the pod's files and recording that it happened.

core-pod.step.finished.says: Working out what an act's file holds beside its description: the runtime that did the work and a snapshot of the pod's files.

core-pod.step.keptafter.says: Bringing the saved answers up to date after a step.

core-pod.step.rebuild-import.says: Re-deriving what the imported records change.

core-pod.step.rebuild-match.says: Re-deriving what the 'same record' matching changes.

core-pod.step.rebuild-other.says: Re-deriving everything else a step changes.

core-pod.import.adapters.says: Reading the adapter that knows how to convert this kind of record.

core-pod.import.documents.says: Taking in the documents (notes, reports) that came with the record.

core-pod.inputshash.says: Working out a fingerprint of everything a result depends on, to know when it can be reused.

core-pod.matcherselect.says: A question the 'same record' matcher puts to the pod's facts, as the matcher reads them.

core-pod.matcherview.says: Preparing the pod's facts for the 'same record' matcher.

core-pod.databaseanswers.says: Checking whether the saved database holds the pod as it stands now, so it can answer in place of a rebuild.

core-pod.rebuild.writeall.says: Writing every rebuilt file out to the pod.

core-pod.rebuild.bytes.says: Turning rebuilt facts into the bytes that are written.

core-pod.keepdatabase.says: Saving the pod's database so the next opening is fast.

core-pod.keepdatabase.whole.says: Saving the database whole, from the pod's current facts.

core-pod.keepbuild.says: Preparing the content of the saved database.

core-pod.keepbuild.dump.says: Gathering the pod's facts to put in the saved database.

core-pod.keepbuild.write.says: Writing the gathered facts into the saved database.

core-pod.compact.says: Tidying the pod's files into fewer, larger ones.
